I posted the draft as a reply in #strategic-random. It's built only from #inc-vtg-hartford, which you're in, and I haven't sent it to Mateo or anyone else.

- First report: 10:42 AM on Aug 3. Gate kiosks were offline and both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.
- Kiosk 1 came back: 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 checked in and dispatch could see it.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM, posted in the incident room at 11:08 AM.

The draft also notes the open status-page access problem for Mateo's account (INC-4821). Mateo's admin account can see arrivals in Pemberline Dock.
